Subject: Platform fee surcharge for air-gapped pilot — tiering and waiver request

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the platform looked solid. We have an 8-week air-gapped pilot we want to run at two hospitals. Before we get our procurement team involved, two quick questions on economics and packaging:  

1) You mentioned a "platform fee" for private deployments. Does that include air-gapped deployments or is there an additional surcharge for on-prem/air-gapped pilots? If there is a surcharge, would Redwood consider waiving or reducing it for a short pilot (3 months)?

2) Can you confirm which support tier is required for an air-gapped install (Standard, Enterprise, SRE retainer)? We expect limited on-call needs during the pilot but will need guided runbook creation and remote troubleshooting windows.

I've attached a short spreadsheet with our pilot requirements and rough timeline. Our procurement contact is procurement@medialabs.com — happy to loop them in once we have a ballpark.

Appreciate any clarity you can share.

Best,

Subject: Re: Platform fee surcharge for air-gapped pilot — tiering and waiver request

Hi Eileen — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated. Short answers up front:

- Platform fee: this is a baseline monthly fee that covers the private control plane, model catalog syncs, and our deployment orchestration. For air-gapped/on-prem installs we typically apply an additional one-time deployment surcharge to cover secure transfer, onsite packaging (if requested), and air-gap-specific validation.

- Pilot waivers: we frequently structure pilot concessions — for a timeboxed 3-month proof-of-value we can reduce or waive the platform fee surcharge depending on the scope and a modest commit to a rollout path.

- Support tier: pilots usually run on "Enterprise" support for the SLA guarantees plus an optional short-term SRE retainer for runbook creation and hand-offs. Given your description (guided runbook + limited on-call) an 8–12 hour/week SRE retainer for the pilot tends to be sufficient.

I'll hand this to Marissa to surface concrete pricing scenarios and to Grace to outline the SRE scope. Can you confirm the pilot start window (you mentioned 'late Sep' on the call) and whether both hospitals will be identical stacks?

Thanks — looping Marissa and Grace in.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Hi Eileen — thanks for the details. Per Avery's note, below are three discrete pricing scenarios to consider (numbers are illustrative; we can tighten once we have the exact scope):

Option A — Pilot waived (preferred for quick POC)
- Platform fee surcharge: WAIVED for 3-month pilot
- Platform fee base (private control plane): $0 (hosted control plane interactions limited for air-gap)
- SRE retainer: discounted to $3,500/week (8 hours/week) for pilot period
- Onboarding engineering days: 4 days remote at $1,200/day (reduced)
- Invoicing: Net 30 at pilot start

Option B — Reduced surcharge + monthly platform fee
- Platform fee surcharge: $5,000 one-time (pilot rate)
- Monthly platform fee (private): $5,000/month (pilot)
- SRE retainer: $5,500/week (12 hours/week)
- Onboarding engineering: 2 onsite days + 3 remote days (estimate)

Option C — Standard commercial (no concession)
- Platform fee surcharge: $18,000 one-time deployment surcharge
- Monthly platform fee (private): $25,000/month
- SRE retainer: standard $9,000/week (as-needed)

Requested next steps:
- Please confirm which option aligns with procurement's expectations. If you want Option A we require a short mutual action plan and a 30-day notice to convert to a paid deployment if you proceed to rollout.
- If procurement needs a PO, share their required billing info and we will generate a pro forma and draft SOW.

Happy to hop on a 20-min pricing call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Sales, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

Hi team — adding a technical view on support and what the SRE retainer covers for an air-gapped pilot: 

Core SRE retainer (pilot-focused, 8–12hrs/week):
- Remote runbook co-authoring and review (deployment steps, rollback, service checks)
- Weekly 1-hour sync + access to our on-call rotation for critical escalations during pilot window (severity S1 response time: 4 hours under Enterprise SLA)
- KV cache warmup guidance and model variant pinning to limit warm-up token costs
- KMS/HSM integration advisory (we do not ship keys)
- Up to 2 remote troubleshooting sessions per week (1.5 hours each)

Optional add-ons:
- Onsite 2-day hardening workshop (recommended if hospital network is highly restrictive)
- Observability retention addon (90-day logs + tokenized cost breakdown) — ~$1,100/month/site
- Extended SRE hours (billed weekly) for go-live windows

Notes on air-gap package: secure artifact transfer and validation are the main cost drivers — if Medialabs can accept our standard secure transfer tooling and neighborhood validation (no onsite media), we can avoid the larger one-time deployment surcharge.

I've attached a draft SRE stanza we typically include in the SOW. Happy to customize.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
